title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-01-25

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a fine show highlighted by an Alligator jam, though the newer material sounds a bit rough.
ai_review.review: The recording is generally solid with a clean soundboard source, but listeners note a slight roughness on the newer songs. The performance shines during the Alligator jam, delivering high energy and a memorable moment despite some unevenness elsewhere.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 4‑star review praises the show’s energy and standout Alligator jam while noting minor roughness, leading to an overall strong but not flawless rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall fine sound; a little rough on newer songs, suggesting slight clarity or balance issues in those sections.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on flow; the show is described as generally fine with a notable jam segment.
